brief_title: A Study of LY4167586 in Participants With Obesity or Overweight With or Without Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: A Phase 1, Randomized, Participant- and Investigator-Blinded, Placebo-Controlled, Parallel-Design Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, and Pharmacodynamics of Multiple Dose Regimens of LY4167586 in Participants With Obesity or Overweight With or Without Type 2 Diabetes

primary_outcomes.measure: Number of Participants with One or More Serious Adverse Event(s) (SAEs) Considered by the Investigator to be Related to Study Drug Administration
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Baseline through Study Completion (Estimated as Week 89)

brief_summary:
The main purpose of this study is to look at how safe and well-tolerated LY4167586 is in participants with obesity or overweight with or without Type 2 Diabetes. Blood tests will be performed to check how much LY4167586 gets into the bloodstream and how long it takes the body to eliminate it following a single administration.

Participation in the study will last between approximately 53 to 89 weeks. For each participant (excluding those in Part B), the study will include between 5 and 7 stays in the Clinical Research Unit (CRU), each stay lasting between approximately 8 and 10 nights.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participants must be 21 in Singapore.
* Have had a self-reported stable weight for 3 months prior to screening (less than approximately 5 percent (%) body weight change.

Part A, B, D, and E

* Have a body mass index (BMI) of greater than or equal to 30 kilograms per square meter (kg/m²) or 27 to less than 30 kg/m² and previously diagnosed with at least one of the following weight-related comorbidities:

  * hypertension
  * dyslipidemia
  * obstructive sleep apnea, or
  * prediabetes.

Part C

* Have a BMI ≥25.0 kg/m²
* Have a diagnosis of Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) for at least 6 months.
* T2D controlled with diet and exercise alone or are on a stable dose of metformin alone, or in combination with a sodium-glucose co-transporter-2 inhibitor (SGLT-2i), for at least 3 months.
* Have a hemoglobin (HbA1c) value of ≥6.5 % and ≤10.0%.

Part D

* To qualify as Chinese for this study, the participant must be at a minimum third-generation Chinese, defined as having all 4 of the participants' biological grandparents being of exclusive Chinese descent and born in China.

Part E

* To qualify as Japanese for this study, the participant must be at a minimum third-generation Japanese, defined as having all 4 of the participants' biological grandparents being of exclusive Japanese descent and born in Japan.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Have a significant history or presence of cardiovascular, respiratory, hepatic, renal, gastrointestinal (GI), endocrine (except for T2D in Part C), hematological, or neurological disorders capable of significantly altering the absorption, metabolism, or elimination of drugs, or of constituting a risk when taking the study drug, or of interfering with the interpretation of data.
